[EN] I won't come until you call me.
[ES] No vendré hasta que me llames.

[EN] Tell me: How did you defeat Vergos? You're too weak.
[ES] Dime: ¿Cómo derrotaste a Vergos? Eres demasiado débil.

[EN] We eliminate anything that stands in our way... but you're not what we're after.
[ES] Eliminamos cualquier cosa que se interponga en nuestro camino... pero tú no eres lo que buscamos.
